caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular box with its lid open, shown at an angle that allows both the inside and outside to be visible. The box appears to be made of a dark-colored material, rendered in shades of gray and black. The inside of the box features a cylindrical compartment at the center, with divider panels radiating outward from the cylinder to the corners, creating four triangular sections within the box. The open lid displays a mottled or patterned surface texture, also in grayscale, indicating wear or staining. The box sits on four short legs, one at each corner, and is placed against a plain, light background. The artist's signature, “Gordon Sanborn,” is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Pa. German Tinder Box
